component.name: OpenLinkHub Client Plus
component.summary: Configure Corsair devices through OpenLinkHub, Keychron keyboards and graphics cards

description.p: OpenLinkHub Client with support for Keychron keyboards and Gigabyte graphics card lighting added. Corsair devices are configured through OpenLinkHub, the open source Linux service for Corsair devices, with an iCUE-style interface. Keychron keyboards with Keychron's open source ZMK firmware and graphics cards are configured by the app itself; OpenLinkHub does not support them and is not involved.

ul.li: Everything OpenLinkHub Client does: key remapping, DPI, lighting, fans and pumps, equalizer, device settings, macros and profiles
Keychron V3 Ultra 8K over USB or the Ultra-Link 8K receiver: keys and knob on every layer, lighting, polling rate, debounce and sleep timers
Gigabyte graphics cards with RGB Fusion 2 lighting: mode, brightness, speed and a colour per zone

description.p: Keychron keyboards need a udev rule for /dev/hidraw access, graphics cards access to /dev/i2c-*; see the project page.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Corsair, Keychron or Gigabyte.
